issues: FantasyCalc coverage (not Fantrax-specific) — https://api.fantasycalc.com/values/current?isDynasty=false&numQbs=1&numTeams=12&ppr=1 HTTP 200 — [].player has 198 entries (RB 57, WR 78, QB 33, TE 30); 26 of the top-200 Fantrax-ADP QB/RB/WR/TE have no value (9 injured or inactive per Sleeper; the other 17 rank #141–#200 among Fantrax-ADP QB/RB/WR/TE) — options: (a) treat uncovered players as config.valueFloor and measure item M only on covered starters, (b) fall back to dynasty values for redraft players missing from the redraft list, (c) keep the ≥ 98% target and report misses.

§2.9's crosswalk sources can't map Fantrax players — FantasyCalc https://api.fantasycalc.com/values/current?isDynasty=false&numQbs=1&numTeams=12&ppr=1 HTTP 200: [].player fields id, mflId, sleeperId, espnId, fleaflickerId, ffpcId (no Fantrax id); DynastyProcess https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dynastyprocess/data/master/files/db_playerids.csv: 35 columns, none for Fantrax — what works is getPlayerIds' vendor ids: 435/435 top-ADP QB/RB/WR/TE and 797/797 QB/RB/WR/TE/K on NFL teams map to a Sleeper id (sleeper.sportradar_id 433, sleeper.rotowire_id 2) — options: (a) the Phase 5 Fantrax adapter uses this vendor-id route (sportRadarId first, rotowireId fallback, duplicates ranked; scripts/lib/fantrax/crosswalk.ts); (b) name matching (rejected: getAdp and getPlayerIds already disagree on spellings).

§2.7's Fantrax endpoint list vs the documented API — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pmurley/go-fantrax/HEAD/README.md HTTP 200 (current as of April 2025): getPlayerIds, getAdp, getLeagues, getLeagueInfo, getDraftPicks, getTeamRosters, getStandings — not in §2.7: getLeagues(userSecretId) (a per-user secret; the only documented way to find the user's own team); no transactions endpoint; go-fantrax's transaction code is all outside its root-level public-API bindings (auth_client/ 4, examples/ 2, models/ 1), so item G is unavailable for Fantrax (docs only, not probed live) — options: (a) 'my team': the user picks their team (no new secret); (b) accept userSecretId as a Phase 5 session-only credential (§3) to list the user's leagues and teams; (c) item G: the acceptance model's activity (a) and hist features default to 0 / unused for Fantrax.

§2.7's open question (are scoring rules exposed?) is unanswered: no public Fantrax league to test — https://www.fantrax.com/fxea/general/getLeagueInfo?leagueId={leagueId} — go-fantrax's LeagueInfo struct (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pmurley/go-fantrax/HEAD/league_info.go HTTP 200) declares scoringSystem with configs {position, cumulative, scoringCategory, points} — options: (a) Parker supplies a public Fantrax NFL league ID (FANTRAX_LEAGUE_ID) and the probe answers it; (b) keep Fantrax a stretch goal with preset scoring (§2.8) until verified.
decisions: Fantrax → canonical IDs: match on sportRadarId (Sleeper sportradar_id), then rotowireId (Sleeper rotowire_id), then DynastyProcess sportradar_id / rotowire_id / stats_id (= Fantrax statsIncId). A vendor id can sit on several rows, so every candidate is kept and the most plausible one wins (real row, active, position + NFL team agree). Never match on names: getAdp and getPlayerIds spell some names differently (API.adp.names).

getPlayerIds records are classified by position as well as by id (recordKind): TK/TQB ("Team K, <city>", "Team QB, <city>") use 5-char player ids but are team units, so they are counted and crosswalked apart from players (API.playerIds.idFormat).

Fantrax bodies are parsed as JSON whatever the Content-Type (getPlayerIds arrived as text/plain), and every body is checked for an error field before use, since errors can come back as HTTP 200 (API.errors).

Caching: getPlayerIds and getAdp 24 h like other player lists, league calls 10 min, docs 7 days. A Fantrax response is cached only when it is a JSON body without an error object (fantraxCacheable), so a transient HTTP-200 error is never replayed; the invalid-ID getLeagueInfo check runs once per run with no retries and keeps its expected error body in the 10-minute league cache.

Fantrax's API docs are read from pmurley/go-fantrax (README, league_info.go, repo tree; 7-day docs cache), so docs-based statements in this report (DOCS.*, G, J, K, C) are computed from those files each run.
Did not look for a public Fantrax league: CLAUDE.md §17 says to skip Fantrax unless someone has a public league ID.
questions: Do you know any public Fantrax NFL league ID we could test with (FANTRAX_LEAGUE_ID)? If not, Fantrax stays a stretch goal.
